ios.desc:
WHERE WILL YOU BE WHEN YOUR FUTURE SELF WILL READ YOUR WORDS?

Wrote Myself a Letter is a calm, private space to pause, reflect, and reconnect with who you are becoming.

Write or record messages for your future self. Capture dreams, fears, goals, gratitude, or simple snapshots of life right now. Choose a date, seal the letter, and let time do the rest.

When the moment arrives, your phone will notify you that a message from your past self has arrived. A quiet invitation to reflect, gain perspective, or simply feel seen by who you once were.

WHAT CAN YOU DO:

• Write or record audio letters to your future self
• Transcribe audio into text when you choose
• Schedule delivery for any date
• Keep letters sealed until the right moment arrives
• Read or listen when the notification unlocks them
• Track past letters while keeping future ones a mystery
• Enjoy daily reflective quotes on a calm home screen
• Use the app completely offline. Nothing leaves your device
• Export your data anytime. You are always in control

A SPACE THAT IS UNIQUELY YOURS

Your letters are stored on your device only.
No accounts. No servers. No tracking. No analytics. No ads. Ever.

Just a quiet place to reflect at your own pace.

A ONE TIME PURCHASE

Wrote Myself a Letter is yours forever.
No subscriptions. No recurring fees.

Whether you are capturing a small moment of joy, recording a turning point, or asking your future self a powerful question, this app helps you build a meaningful conversation across time.

Where will you be when your letter arrives?

quotes.text:
I have been working on the latest update to my app: Wrote Myself a Letter which I finished after being laid off.
The idea is to send a letter to your future self, which I personally find very therapeutic in many ways, but what is important is the app is fully offline, has 0 tracking, ads or subscriptions. It's a once off purchase and own forever, which is something I wish was more common these days.
Check it out and, if for any reason you can't afford it just write me and I will send you a key.

Love from Australia:

https://apps.apple.com/au/app/wrote-myself-a-letter/id6478266502

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zeroplusone.wmal&hl=en_AU
